inside_hollywood_w_booths_and_people.notes: Master view from the top of the hall steps. Coffer, cove, ceiling edge, the central columns (plan row -20.75) and the ING TV wall line up within a few pixels. Behind them the plan's booth islands, the middle aisle running past the stairwells to the schedule screen on the curtained north wall; booth graphics are simple colour panels and names. Plan error, fixed here: the plan's columns at (-3.8, -27.28) and (2.65, -27.28) are not there in reality (the coffer spans that bay), so they are left out.
